goal: Bound each Stripe call made inside applyTierChangeInTx while the tier entitlement + billing advisory locks and FOR UPDATE are held to a short per-call { timeout: 8000, maxNetworkRetries: 0 }, capping worst-case advisory-lock hold from ~60s+ to ~24s, with no structural restructure of tier-change.ts.
non_goals: No restructure of applyTierChangeInTx / buildTierChangeProviderPlan / mutateStripe (LOCKED minimal fix).
No moving Stripe calls out of the sql.begin transaction or out of the lock scope.
No new bounded Stripe client on the factory (getStripe stays the single client owner; per-call RequestOptions override instead).
No new timeout-recovery / reconcile code path: rely on existing per-step Stripe idempotency keys + caller retry (same Idempotency-Key) + the customer.subscription.updated webhook reconcile.
No change to the shared STRIPE_CLIENT_CONFIG defaults (20s / 2 retries) used by all other call sites.
user_visible_behavior: A tier change where a Stripe call hangs fails after ~8s per call (route returns 502 tier_change_failed) instead of holding the tier-change advisory locks for up to ~60s+.
No change to the success path: a normal tier change still succeeds with the same billing outcome and audit.
invariants: Every Stripe call executed inside applyTierChangeInTx (subscriptions.retrieve, base subscriptionItems.update, and the overage update/create/del) carries timeout=8000 and maxNetworkRetries=0.
Every mutating Stripe call keeps its stable per-step idempotency key tier-change:{accountId}:{operationKey}:{step} unchanged.
The bound value has a single authoritative owner (one named constant), not repeated literals per call site.
On any Stripe failure/timeout the DB transaction rolls back (no tier snapshot, no audit) exactly as today; the change never partially commits DB state.
getStripe() remains the sole Stripe client factory; no second client is constructed.
edge_cases: Overage mutation kind = update: base update + overage update both bounded.
Overage mutation kind = create: base update + overage create both bounded.
Overage mutation kind = delete: base update + overage del both bounded.
Overage mutation kind = none: base update bounded, no overage call.
subscriptions.retrieve (read) call is bounded even though it currently passes no RequestOptions arg.
Idempotent replay path (committed audit already present): returns early before any Stripe call — no bound needed, must not regress.

A bounded call that times out AFTER Stripe processed the mutation: tx rolls back, DB unchanged; recovery via caller retry (Stripe idempotency replay) or customer.subscription.updated webhook — pre-existing, unchanged.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/accounts/tier-change.ts stripeOptions() helper already returns the RequestOptions arg ({ idempotencyKey }) — extend it to add the bound.
stripe 22.2.0 per-request override: both timeout and maxNetworkRetries overridable per call (node_modules/stripe/README.md:247); maxNetworkRetries:0 disables retries.
